claims.claim: There is no single shelter exit timer. Under rocket fire the rule is at least 10 minutes; under ballistic missile fire there is no automatic timed exit and the instruction is to remain until an official all-clear arrives via the Home Front Command app and Cell Broadcast, because salvos arrive in sequence and interception fragments keep falling for minutes. The 10-minute line on the app alert screen is leftover wording from earlier operations.

claims.claim: The 2025 AHA and AAP pediatric guidelines removed the two-finger infant compression technique and recommend two thumbs-encircling hands or one-hand, with heel-of-one-hand when the rescuer cannot encircle the chest
claims.raw_snippet: For infants, the recommended compression techniques include using either the one-hand technique or the two thumbs-encircling hands technique. notes.note: The legacy OREF URL https://www.oref.org.il/12487-17292-he/Pakar.aspx that previously backed the shelter-timing claims is dead. Re-checked 2026-08-09: it returns HTTP 301 to https://www.oref.org.il/heb/articles/info/iron-swords/1103, which in turn resolves to a gov.il 404 error page. The whole legacy Pakar.aspx URL scheme was retired when OREF migrated to its single-page app. Recorded as a note, not a claim, because there is no page text to quote. Superseded 2026-08-13: the live article is readable through the oref.org.il content API and now backs the shelter-timing claims.

The former claims "approximately 1,700 alert zones" and "Arava/Eilat up to 3 minutes" were dropped on 2026-08-13. The live OREF article on protection time (articles/protection-guidelines/preparing-protected-space/1103) states the entry time ranges from immediate up to a minute and a half and never mentions 1,700 zones or a 3-minute window. The skill body was corrected to the sourced range.
